functions.title: Job Descriptions
content: Responsible for the end to end development life cycle and continuous maintenance of Infoshare software products.
Gather overall requirements of assigned projects and coordinate the support of UI/UX design, hard code development and QA efforts from specific teams.
Develop the deployment flow control strategy to optimize customer satisfaction.
Participate in advancing low-code development, optimizing data pipelines and refining document templates and interfaces.
Enhance software functionalities, streamline processes, and elevate user experience.
Provide support of existing Infoshare web applications including troubleshooting, testing, business rule changes, and routine tasks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, ensure scalability and maintain a high product standard and excellence.

functions.title: Requirement
content: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Analytics Engineering or Mathematics or a related discipline with at least12 months experience.
Must have training or practical skills in Law Enforcement & Public Safety domain knowledge, GJXML interface, low code development, and UI/UX design.
